semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in advanced chip packaging technologies, particularly for high-end chips.
summary: Changsha Anmuquan Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on high-end chip packaging, particularly through advanced flip-chip-system-in-package (FC-SiP) technology. Established in 2019, the company has achieved mass production of large chip packages and collaborates with leading domestic CPU and FPGA companies.
capabilities: Independent packaging for high-end large chips
Mass production of large chip packages

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Hunan Xiangjiang New Area and is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise.
